Vibrio consensus identification matrix

Source: R/keys.R
vibrio.Rd

Biochemical and growth test results for 74 Vibrio taxa from Noguerola & Blanch (2008), one row per taxon. vibrioKey() generates a key from it.

Usage

vibrio

Format

A data frame with 74 rows and 46 columns: species, then 45 tests coded as in the paper: + positive, - negative, (+) / (-) mostly positive / negative, v or d variable, ND not determined (and one blank cell in the source, NA). Tests under the paper's "Acid from" and "Resistance to" headings are named with that prefix.

Source

Noguerola I, Blanch AR (2008). Identification of Vibrio spp. with a set of dichotomous keys. Journal of Applied Microbiology 105, 175-185. doi:10.1111/j.1365-2672.2008.03730.x . Extracted from the paper's table; see data-raw/vibrio/ in the package sources.
